name: Create custom content
description: Create custom content Creates a new custom content in the given space, page, blogpost or other custom content. POST /wiki/api/v2/custom-content
context:
POST /wiki/api/v2/custom-content
Creates a new custom content in the given space, page, blogpost or other custom content. Only one of `spaceId`, `pageId`, `blogPostId`, or `customContentId` is required in the request body. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the content of the page or blogpost and its corresponding space. Permission to create custom content in the space.
Required: body (body)

name: Create content property for custom content
description: Create content property for custom content Creates a new content property for a piece of custom content. POST /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{custom-content-id}/properties
context:
POST /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{custom-content-id}/properties
Creates a new content property for a piece of custom content. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to update the custom content.
Required: custom-content-id (path) — The ID of the custom content to create a property for.; body (body) — The content property to be created

name: Delete custom content
description: Delete custom content Delete a custom content by id. DELETE /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}
context:
DELETE /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}
Delete a custom content by id. Deleting a custom content will either move it to the trash or permanently delete it (purge it), depending on the apiSupport. To permanently delete a **trashed** custom content, the endpoint must be called with the following param `purge=true`. **[Permissions](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/what-are-confluences-roles/) required**: Permission to view the content of the page or blogpost and its corresponding space. Permission to delete custom content in the space. [`manage/content`](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-space-permissions/#api-space-permissions-get) permission for the space (if attempting to purge). **Note:** To find the display name for each permission ID, call the [Get available space permissions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-space-permissions/#api-space-permissions-get) API.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the custom content to be deleted.
Optional: purge (query) — If attempting to purge the custom content.

name: Delete content property for custom content by id
description: Delete content property for custom content by id Deletes a content property for a piece of custom content by its id. DELETE /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{custom-content-id}/properties/{property-id}

name: Get child custom content
description: Get child custom content Returns all child custom content for given custom content id. GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}/children
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}/children
Returns all child custom content for given custom content id. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission). Only custom content that the user has permission to view will be returned.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the parent custom content. If you don't know the custom content ID, use Get custom-content and filter the results.
Optional: cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of pages per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.

name: Get attachments for custom content
description: Get attachments for custom content Returns the attachments of specific custom content. GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}/attachments
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}/attachments
Returns the attachments of specific custom content. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the content of the custom content and its corresponding space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the custom content for which attachments should be returned.
Optional: sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; status (query) — Filter the results to attachments based on their status. By default, `current` and `archived` are used.; mediaType (query) — Filters on the mediaType of attachments. Only one may be specified.; filename (query) — Filters on the file-name of attachments. Only one may be specified.; limit (query) — Maximum number of attachments per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get custom content by id
description: Get custom content by id Returns a specific piece of custom content. GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/custom-content/{id}
Returns a specific piece of custom content. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the custom content, the container of the custom content, and the corresponding space (if different from the container).
Required: id (path) — The ID of the custom content to be returned. If you don't know the custom content ID, use Get Custom Content by Type and filter the results.
Optional: body-format (query) — The content format types to be returned in the `body` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `body` field. Note: If the custom content body type is `storage`, the `storage` and `atlas_doc_format` body formats are able to be returned. If the custom content body type is `raw`, only the `raw` body format is able to be returned.; version (query) — Allows you to retrieve a previously published version. Specify the previous version's number to retrieve its details.; include-labels (query) — Includes labels associated with this custom content in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-properties (query) — Includes content properties associated with this custom content in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-operations (query) — Includes operations associated with this custom content in the response, as defined in the `Operation` object. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-versions (query) — Includes versions associated with this custom content in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-version (query) — Includes the current version associated with this custom content in the response. By default this is included and can be omitted by setting the value to `false`.; include-collaborators (query) — Includes collaborators on the custom content.

Note: If the custom content body type is `storage`, the `storage` and `atlas_doc_format` body formats are able to be returned. If the custom content body type is `raw`, only the `raw` body format is able to be returned.
